mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAY_CALLBACK_LOG ( ID, ORDER_NO, CALLBACK_TYPE, CALLBACK_STATUS, REFUND_ORDER_NO, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, CHANNEL_ORDER_NO, MERCHANT_REFUND_NO, REFUND_NO, CHANNEL_REFUND_NO, PAY_TIME, REFUND_TIME, TOTAL_AMOUNT, CASH_AMOUNT, COUPON_AMOUNT, REFUND_AMOUNT, PAY_USER_ID, PAYMENT_VENDOR, TXN_DATE, RAW_BODY, DISCOUNT_INFO, HANDLE_STATUS, HANDLE_MSG, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAY_CALLBACK_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{callbackType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{callbackStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refundOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{merchantOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{channelOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{merchantRefundNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refundNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{channelRefundNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refundTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cashAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{couponAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{refundAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paymentVendor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{txnDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rawBody,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{discountInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{handleStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{handleMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, CALLBACK_TYPE, CALLBACK_STATUS, CHANNEL_ORDER_NO, PAY_TIME, TOTAL_AMOUNT, CASH_AMOUNT, COUPON_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(RAW_BODY, 2000, 1) AS RAW_BODY, HANDLE_STATUS, CREATE_TIME FROM ( SELECT ID, ORDER_NO, MERCHANT_ORDER_NO, CALLBACK_TYPE, CALLBACK_STATUS, CHANNEL_ORDER_NO, PAY_TIME, TOTAL_AMOUNT, CASH_AMOUNT, COUPON_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_VENDOR, RAW_BODY, HANDLE_STATUS, CREATE_TIME FROM PAY_CALLBACK_LOG WHERE MERCHANT_ORDER_NO = #{merchantOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CALLBACK_TYPE = #{callbackType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC, ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT HANDLE_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY MERCHANT_ORDER_NO ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC, ID DESC ) AS RN FROM PAY_CALLBACK_LOG WHERE TXN_DATE >= #{txnDateFrom,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CALLBACK_TYPE = 'PAY' AND MERCHANT_ORDER_NO IS NOT NULL ) WHERE RN = 1 AND HANDLE_STATUS = 'MANUAL'
